Going by the consensus network from the Sachs et al. flow cytometry study, which this dataset appears to be, p38 and p44/42 (Erk) have no direct edge. This is from my recollection of that network. I didn't run any analysis on `flow.csv`.

- p38 is regulated by PKC and PKA.
- p44/42 (Erk) sits in the Raf → Mek → Erk cascade, with Akt acting downstream of it.
- The two proteins are correlated only because upstream signals such as PKA affect both. That shared cause doesn't make either one a cause of the other.

ANSWER: C
